questions.prompt: Which distinction between slice() and splice() is correct?
options: slice() removes matching values by predicate.
splice() creates a deep clone of nested objects.
slice() returns a selected portion without changing the original array; splice() mutates the array.
Both methods always mutate the original array.
questions.explanation: slice() copies a range; splice() edits the receiver and returns removed elements.

questions.prompt: What should you remember about spread syntax on an object with nested objects?
options: The copy is shallow; nested object references can still be shared.
It always performs a deep clone.
It serializes the object to JSON.
questions.explanation: Spread copies enumerable own properties one level deep, so nested objects may still be aliased.
